scanNote:
GRAMMAR 15-BET. Unit 3 — some/any, this/these, ko'plik va 1-3-unitlar takrori.

Skaner bilan tekshirildi. HAMMASI TO'G'RI: 9-mashq (10), 10-mashq (15 ta xatoni tuzatish), 11-mashq (12), 12-mashq (16) — jami 53 ta javob.

⚠ SOME / ANY / A / AN — TO'RT QOIDA (9-mashq shu to'rttasini aralashtiradi):
  SOME — TASDIQ gapda, ko'plik: 'There are SOME flowers'
  ANY  — INKOR va SAVOL gapda, ko'plik: 'Are there ANY towels?', 'There aren't ANY drawings'
  A/AN — BIRLIK: 'There isn't A bedroom', 'There isn't AN armchair'
  ⚠ Ya'ni avval SON ni aniqlang (birlikmi/ko'plikmi), keyin GAP TURINI (tasdiq/inkor/savol).

⚠ 10-MAShQ — BESh XIL XATO TURI:
  • some/any almashtirilgan (2, 4, 8, 10, 14-bandlar)
  • this/that birlikda, these/those ko'plikda (3, 9, 11, 13-bandlar)
  • is/are ega soniga mos emas (7, 15-bandlar)
  • ot ko'pligi noto'g'ri: 'his glass' → GLASSES (5-band)
  • qisqa javob gapga zid: 'Yes, there ISN'T' → THERE IS (12-band)

⚠ 11-MAShQ 3 va 12-BAND — KO'PLIK IMLOSI: '-ch' va '-sh' bilan tugagan ot '-ES' oladi: torch → TORCHES, bench → BENCHES.

⚠ 12-MAShQ 11-BAND: 'WE haven't got' — 'we' bilan 'have', shuning uchun inkori 'haven't' ('hasn't' emas).

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in a, an, some or any.
exercises.instructionUz: a, an, some yoki any so'zini qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
QAROR DARAXTI:

  Ot KO'PLIKMI?
    ha  → gap tasdiqmi?  ha → SOME
                          yo'q (inkor/savol) → ANY
    yo'q (birlik) → keyingi so'z unli tovush bilanmi?
                          ha → AN
                          yo'q → A

DIQQAT: birlik otda 'any' HECH QACHON ishlatilmaydi —
inkor yoki savol bo'lsa ham:
  ✅ There isn't A bedroom downstairs.
  ❌ There isn't any bedroom downstairs.

items.textEn: 1  There are ____ flowers in the vase.
2  Are there ____ towels in the bathroom?
3  There are ____ books in the bookcase.
4  There aren't ____ chairs in the kitchen.
5  There are ____ magazines on the table.
6  There isn't ____ bedroom downstairs.
items.whyUz: 'bedroom' BIRLIK — inkor bo'lsa ham 'any' emas. /b/ undosh → a.

items.textEn: 7  Are there ____ flats for rent in the area?
8  There aren't ____ drawings on the wall.
items.whyUz: 'drawings' ko'plik, inkor gap → any. drawing = chizma, surat.

items.textEn: 9  There are ____ plants in the garden.
10  There isn't ____ armchair in the dining-room.
items.whyUz: 'armchair' birlik va UNLI tovush /ɑː/ bilan boshlanadi → an.

exercises.instructionEn: Correct the mistakes, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
Bu mashq — Unit 3 ning ENG FOYDALI mashqi. Har bir gapda
BITTA xato bor va u eng ko'p uchraydigan xatolardan biri.

BESH XIL XATO TURI:

  1) is/are mos emas
     'There IS two cups' → There ARE two cups

  2) some/any noto'g'ri
     'There aren't SOME dresses' → There aren't ANY dresses

  3) this/that ko'plik ot bilan
     'THAT are my books' → THOSE are my books

  4) ot birlikda qolgan
     'These are his GLASS' → These are his GLASSES

  5) qisqa javob mantiqan noto'g'ri
     'Yes, there ISN'T' → Yes, there IS

NAMUNA: There is two cups on the table. → are

items.textEn: 1  There is two cups on the table.
items.whyUz: Kitobdagi namuna. 'two cups' ko'plik → There ARE.

items.textEn: 2  There aren't some dresses in the wardrobe.
items.whyUz: Inkor gapda ko'plik ot bilan 'some' emas, 'any' ishlatiladi.

items.textEn: 3  That are my books.
items.whyUz: 'books' ko'plik va fe'l 'are' — demak olmosh ham ko'plik bo'lishi kerak: Those.

items.textEn: 4  There are any keys on the desk.
5  These are his glass.
items.whyUz: 'These are' ko'plik — demak ot ham ko'plik: glass → glasses (-ss → -es).

items.textEn: 6  There isn't some church on this street.
7  Those is brushes.
8  There are any beds in the bedroom.
9  This aren't my towels.
items.whyUz: 'aren't' ko'plik va 'towels' ko'plik → olmosh ham ko'plik: These.

items.textEn: 10  There aren't some flowers in the vase.
11  This isn't my cars.
items.whyUz: 'cars' ko'plik — olmosh ham, fe'l ham o'zgaradi: These aren't my cars.

items.textEn: 12  Is there a vase on the table? Yes, there isn't.
items.whyUz: 'Yes' bilan boshlangan javob INKOR bo'lolmaydi. To'g'risi: Yes, there is.

items.textEn: 13  These is our cats.
14  Are there some oranges in the fridge?
15  There are a lamp on my desk.

exercises.explanationUz:
O'n ikkita gap — Unit 3 ning barcha mavzulari aralash:
predlog, some/any, ko'plik, a/an, this/these, there is/are.

Har bir gapda avval OTGA qarang (birlikmi-ko'plikmi),
keyin GAP TURIGA (tasdiqmi-inkormi-savolmi).

items.textEn: 1  There is a carpet ____ the floor.
2  There aren't ____ cushions on the armchair.
3  I have got two ____ .
4  There is ____ owl in the tree.
items.whyUz: 'owl' /aʊ/ unli tovush bilan boshlanadi → an. owl = boyqush.

items.textEn: 5  Are there ____ curtains in the room?
6  There ____ any desks in the classroom.
items.whyUz: 'any' tasdiq gapda ishlatilmaydi — demak gap INKOR: There aren't any desks.

items.textEn: 7  ____ are pencils.
8  There is ____ egg in the fridge.
9  ____ is my bicycle.
10  Are there ____ books in the bookcase?
11  There is a lamp ____ the dressing-table.
12  Are there any ____ in the garden?
items.whyUz: 'any' ko'plik ot bilan → benches (-ch bilan tugaydi → -es).

exercises.explanationUz:
TAKRORLASH — 1, 2 va 3-unitlarning barcha grammatikasi.

  Unit 1: to be (am/is/are), a/an, so'roq so'zlar (Who/Where/What)
  Unit 2: have got / has got
  Unit 3: ko'plik, this/these/that/those, there is/are,
          some/any, o'rin predloglari

Bu mashq — o'zingizni sinash uchun. Xato qilsangiz, o'sha
mavzuni qaytadan ko'rib chiqing.

items.textEn: 1  There is ____ orange on the table.
items.whyUz: 'orange' /ɒ/ unli tovush bilan boshlanadi → an. 'some' faqat ko'plik bilan.

items.textEn: 2  I ____ from China.
3  Are there ____ glasses in the cupboard?
4  He ____ got three children.
items.whyUz: he/she/it bilan HAS GOT. Unit 2 mavzusi.

items.textEn: 5  There is a vase ____ the table.
6  ____ are rabbits.
items.whyUz: 'are' va 'rabbits' ko'plik → These (yoki Those). Variantlar ichida faqat 'These' ko'plik.

items.textEn: 7  ____ is he from?
items.whyUz: 'from' — joy so'raladi → Where. 'Where is he from?' = U qayerdan?

items.textEn: 8  There is a swimming-pool ____ the garden.
items.whyUz: Bog' — chegarasi bor hudud → IN the garden.

items.textEn: 9  Have you got ____ apples?
10  Mary's ____ the balcony.
items.whyUz: Balkon — ochiq yuza → ON the balcony. 'Mary's' = Mary is.

items.textEn: 11  We ____ got a dishwasher.
items.whyUz: I/you/we/they bilan HAVE. Inkor: haven't got.

items.textEn: 12  ____ is my bed.
items.whyUz: Karavotni ko'rsatib aytilyapti → This is my bed. 'These' ko'plik bo'lgani uchun mos emas.

items.textEn: 13  He is ____ doctor.
items.whyUz: 'doctor' /d/ undosh tovush bilan boshlanadi → a. Kasb oldida artikl SHART.

items.textEn: 14  You can see ____ lions at the zoo.
15  There's ____ armchair in the living-room.
items.whyUz: 'armchair' birlik va unli tovush bilan boshlanadi → an. 'There's' = There is.

items.textEn: 16  Are there ____ pictures in your room?

wordFormation.introUz: Grammar Book 15-bet — mashqlardagi yangi otlar va ularning ko'pligi.

groups.ruleUz: have got / has got — inkor shakli

groups.explanationUz: Apostrof + s ikki butunlay boshqa narsani bildiradi. Kontekstdan farqlanadi.
Bu betda uchragan barcha 'an' talab qiladigan otlar.

patterns.exampleEn: There isn't a bedroom downstairs. There's an armchair in the living-room.
patterns.exampleUz: Past qavatda yotoqxona yo'q. Mehmonxonada kreslo bor.
patterns.explanationUz:
Birlik otda inkor bo'lsa ham 'any' EMAS, 'a/an' ishlatiladi.
Bu — eng ko'p uchraydigan xato.

patterns.formula: There are + some + ko'plik ot. / There aren't + any + ko'plik ot.
patterns.exampleEn: There are some plants in the garden. There aren't any drawings on the wall.
patterns.exampleUz: Bog'da o'simliklar bor. Devorda chizmalar yo'q.
patterns.explanationUz: some — tasdiq, any — inkor va savol. Faqat ko'plik bilan.

patterns.formula: Are there any + ko'plik ot ...? / Have you got any ...?
patterns.exampleEn: Are there any flats for rent in the area? Have you got any apples?
patterns.exampleUz: Bu hududda ijaraga beriladigan kvartiralar bormi? Sizda olma bormi?
patterns.explanationUz: 'any' faqat 'there is/are' bilan emas, 'have got' bilan ham ishlatiladi.

patterns.formula: This/That + IS + birlik. / These/Those + ARE + ko'plik.
patterns.exampleEn: This is my bicycle. Those are pencils. These are rabbits.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu mening velosipedim. Ular qalamlar. Bular quyonlar.
patterns.explanationUz:
Olmosh, fe'l va ot — uchalasi bir vaqtda o'zgaradi.
Xatolarni tuzatish mashqidagi eng ko'p uchraydigan muammo shu.

patterns.formula: Where is he from? — He's from China.
patterns.exampleEn: Where is he from? I am from China.
patterns.explanationUz:
Kelib chiqishni so'rash: 'Where ... from?' — 'from' gap OXIRIDA qoladi.
Unit 1 mavzusi.
